**(a)** Form $\frac00$: $\displaystyle\lim\frac{3\cos3x}{1}=3$ **(M1)(A1)**

**(b)** $\frac00$ twice: $\displaystyle\lim\frac{\sin x}{2x}=\lim\frac{\cos x}{2}=\frac12$ **(A1)** — or use $\cos x\approx1-\frac{x^{2}}{2}$ from the Maclaurin series.

**(a)** $\frac00\to\displaystyle\lim\frac{e^{x}-1}{2x}$, still $\frac00$ **(M1)** $\to\displaystyle\lim\frac{e^{x}}{2}=\frac12$ **(A1)**

**(b)** $\frac\infty\infty\to\displaystyle\lim\frac{2x}{e^{x}}\to\lim\frac{2}{e^{x}}=0$ **(M1)(A1)**

Check the indeterminate form before **each** application of the rule.
